requirements.requirement: The system must include a 'board_certification' object in the provider evaluation response payload returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate the 'board_certification' object using the scoring output defined in EVAL-BOARD-ST-001.
The system must include certification list, relevance score, and confidence fields within the 'board_certification' object.
The system must ensure the board certification measure is included for every provider evaluation response when scoring data is available.
The system must not alter or remove existing fields in the evaluate_care_facade response payload when adding the board certification measure.
The system must maintain backward-compatible response structure for downstream consumers when introducing the new measure.
The system must return a null or empty 'board_certification' object when no certification data is available for a provider.
The system must return a relevance score of 0 when certifications exist but none match the queried specialty.
The system must gracefully handle missing or malformed scoring output from EVAL-BOARD-ST-002 without failing the entire provider response.
The system must ensure the board certification measure is serializable into JSON and consumable by chat/UI clients.
The system must expose board certification data in a format that allows LLM-based consumers to interpret certification names without additional transformation.
The system must include human-readable certification labels suitable for natural language generation by downstream LLM components.
The system must include a numeric relevance score that can be directly used by LLMs for ranking or explanation without recalculation.
The system must include a confidence value that allows LLMs to qualify uncertainty in explanations.
The system must ensure consistent field naming and structure across providers to prevent LLM misinterpretation.
The system must not include duplicate certification entries within the 'board_certification' object.
The system must preserve ordering of certifications if provided by the scoring logic, or otherwise return them in deterministic order.
